name: GitHub Pages
description: Static sites and SPAs (and Next.js static export) deployed by a GitHub Actions workflow.

specSections.title: Environments & Configuration
specSections.guidance: Production only (Pages has no previews): the site URL (project site base path or custom domain), the public build-time values and where they come from (repository variables), and for a backend the cross-origin setup: API_BASE_URL with the frontend prefix and the Pages origin in CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. State that everything in the bundle is public.

exclusive.reason: The deploy-engineer is the only agent for the Pages workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml) (§4.18).

checklist.item: pages.yml triggers on the default branch with permissions contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write, the github-pages environment and the right artifact path
The base path and router basename are handled for project sites, with a 404.html SPA fallback where needed
Only public build-time values reach the bundle; the cross-origin API URL comes from a repository variable
Deploy steps exist only in pages.yml, not in ci.yml
.env.example lists every variable the app needs, with placeholders only
